name: phasync/tether
description: Live server-side components for PHP: each browser tab is tethered to its component state on the server. For any PSR-15 application on the swerve application server.

suggest.phasync/phasync-ext: A component's run() and event handlers wait cooperatively for I/O (a database query, an HTTP call) under it, so one tab's slow call no longer stalls every other open tab on the worker; works fully without it.
